local_dashboard.title: Dashboard
local_dashboard.subtitle: Antigravity local token usage
local_dashboard.unreadable_databases: {{count}} local conversation database(s) could not be read. Statistics may be incomplete.
local_dashboard.total_tokens_hint: Sum of input, output and cached tokens within the selected date range.
local_dashboard.input_tokens_hint: Request input tokens within the selected date range, including system prompts and excluding cache hits.
local_dashboard.output_tokens_hint: Generated output tokens within the selected date range, including response text and thinking tokens.
local_dashboard.account_status_hint: Scope: {{scope}}. Available requires valid observations with both 5-hour and weekly quota above the {{threshold}}% reserve. Disabled, restricted or at-reserve accounts are unavailable; missing, stale or incomplete observations are unknown. Live login validity is not checked here.
local_dashboard.quota_used_hint: Uses the menu's family scope and account visibility settings. Usage is 100% minus the mean remaining quota of valid accounts, not summed capacity. Missing or stale observations are excluded; known zero quota is included. Weekly quota follows the account's reported reset window, independently of the usage date range.
local_dashboard.average_input_hint: Total input and cached input tokens divided by request count in the selected date range, including system prompts and all models. Measures average request size, not an individual context length or a model's context limit; it does not establish the cause of response latency.
local_dashboard.first_text_hint: Elapsed time from model request to first response text. Median of the latest 10 eligible responses within 7 days, across all models and local desktop/CLI records. Excludes app startup and UI rendering; independent of the usage date range.
local_dashboard.body_speed_hint: Response tokens divided by streaming duration, summarized as the median of the same response samples. Excludes thinking, tool calls, replies under 100 response tokens and streaming under 1 second. This is an aggregate estimate of recent usage, not a single-model benchmark.
local_dashboard.cache_hit_rate_hint: Cached tokens as a share of total input: cached tokens / (input tokens + cached tokens).
local_dashboard.api_cost_hint: API-equivalent cost calculated from matched model prices, not a subscription bill. Unpriced models are excluded from the total.
local_dashboard.model_details_desc: {{range}} input, output, cached tokens and requests
local_dashboard.no_token_records: No local generation records in the selected date range.
local_dashboard.unpriced_models_hint: {{count}} models unpriced; excluded from the estimate

auto_switch.title: Smart Auto-Switch Strategy
auto_switch.description: Select an eligible backup account when the current account reaches the quota threshold.
auto_switch.wait_instructions: Wait until no recent task activity is detected, then close the affected client, switch accounts and reopen it.
auto_switch.stop_instructions: Attempt to close the affected client or interrupt the VS Code task before switching. Running work may be interrupted.
auto_switch.target_hint_all: Syncs Desktop App, CLI, IDE, and VS Code extension credentials
auto_switch.target_hint_app_cli: Syncs Desktop App and CLI session only
auto_switch.target_hint_vscode: Hot-swaps VS Code extension credentials in-place without restarting editor
auto_switch.model_all_hint: Switches when any monitored model drops below threshold
auto_switch.model_gemini_hint: Monitors Gemini native models quota only
auto_switch.model_claude_hint: Monitors Claude and 3rd-party models quota only
auto_switch.reserve_hint: Trigger switch when current account's 5-hour quota drops below this
auto_switch.candidate_hint: Backup accounts must have 5-hour quota above this threshold to switch in (Free tier uses its own cycle)
auto_switch.accounts_hint: Drag selected accounts to set their order. Disabled and blocked accounts are excluded.
auto_switch.no_accounts: Add accounts and refresh their quotas first.
auto_switch.safety_note: Activity detection cannot confirm that every task has finished. Running work is not transferred to the new account; save your work before switching.
auto_switch.candidate_min_error: Backup quota must exceed switch threshold
auto_switch.no_candidate_error: Select at least one eligible backup account when enabled
auto_switch.load_failed: Could not load settings or accounts. Please try again.
auto_switch.status_failed: Could not read switch status. Check Settings.
auto_switch.action_failed: The action did not complete. Refresh status before retrying.
auto_switch.stop_step_1: At the threshold, the tool attempts to close the affected client or interrupt the VS Code task.
auto_switch.stop_step_2: Credentials are updated after the required checks. The affected desktop client may restart.
auto_switch.stop_step_3: Check the selected account in the client, then resume your work.
auto_switch.stop_warning: Running tasks may be interrupted. Conversation progress is not guaranteed to be preserved.
auto_switch.manual_continue: Account credentials updated. Confirm the account in the client before resuming.

reasons.waiting_task_finish: Recent task activity detected; waiting to switch
reasons.paused_and_updated: Credentials updated after an interruption attempt; check the task before resuming
reasons.no_current_account: No current account identified. Sync or select one first.
reasons.no_quota: No usable quota data; switching is paused
reasons.stale_quota: Quota data is stale; waiting for a refresh
reasons.unknown_pool: Cannot confirm every applicable quota window; switching is paused
reasons.no_candidate: No backup account has enough available quota
reasons.clients_running: Client is running; waiting for it to close
reasons.process_unknown: Cannot confirm client status; switching is paused
reasons.credentials_changed: Client credentials differ from the recorded account. Sync accounts again.
reasons.source_changed: The current account changed; this switch was stopped
reasons.canceled_until_recovery: Switch canceled until quota recovers. Save settings to re-enable sooner.
reasons.switch_failed: Switch incomplete; credentials may be partially updated. Check accounts before re-enabling.
reasons.unsupported_client: This client version does not support this safe switching mode
reasons.state_unavailable: Cannot read or save switch state; switching is paused

auto_switch.strategy_round_robin_desc: Start after the current account, following the candidate order.
auto_switch.strategy_priority_desc: Use the first eligible account in the candidate order.
auto_switch.drag_instructions: Press Space to pick up, arrow keys to move, Space to drop, or Escape to cancel.
